# RDTAXCASES.com

> The most extensive database of international R&D tax credit case law on the internet, maintained by Swanson Reed. Each entry summarizes a real, verified court or tax-tribunal decision addressing research and development tax credit eligibility, documentation, or calculation.

RDTAXCASES.com indexes primary-source case law relevant to R&D tax credits — currently U.S. federal decisions and case law from individual U.S. states, with additional countries planned. Every case page includes the case name, citation, deciding court, year, and a plain-language summary of the holding.

## Sections

- [USA Federal cases](https://rdtaxcases.com/usa/federal): R&D tax credit case law decided by U.S. federal courts (Tax Court, Courts of Appeals, etc.)
- [USA State cases](https://rdtaxcases.com/usa/states): R&D tax credit case law organized by individual U.S. state
- [Search](https://rdtaxcases.com/search): full-text search across all case entries
- [About](https://rdtaxcases.com/about): background on the database and its methodology

## Notes

- Every case page is reachable at `https://rdtaxcases.com/cases/{slug}` and is listed in [sitemap.xml](https://rdtaxcases.com/sitemap.xml).
- Case content is a summary of the original decision, not a verbatim reproduction; refer to the official decision for the authoritative text.
- This is a static, non-commercial reference resource. Publisher: Swanson Reed (https://swansonreed.com).
